:::{#def-realization}
#### Realization (observed value)

A **realization** of a [random variable](#def-random-variable) $X$
is the value $x = X(\outcome)$ it takes
for the outcome $\outcome$ that the [random experiment](probability-basics.qmd#def-random-experiment) produced.

:::

::: {.remark .notes}

The random variable $X$ is the rule, before the experiment is run;
the realization $x$ is one number, after it is run.
Probabilities such as $\Pr(X = x)$ describe the rule,
and a realization is a fixed number.

:::
